assets.subject: Indoor HVLS recirculation versus mechanical outdoor-air supply and exhaust
assets.creation_method: original editable SVG drawn for HVLS 360 editorial
assets.alt_text: Side-by-side warehouse schematics show a ceiling fan circulating air inside a building and a separate system bringing in outdoor air while exhausting indoor air.
assets.caption: An HVLS ceiling fan circulates indoor air; a separate ventilation system can introduce outdoor air and remove indoor air. Conceptual illustration.
